d:
The Tamil Nadu government, led by CM Joseph Vijay, has filed a review petition in the Supreme Court challenging its November 20, 2026 interim order that granted one-time permission to light the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam lamp at the disputed 'Deepathoon' stone pillar on Madurai's Thiruparankundram Hill on November 24.
